title: acis autumnalis var. oporantha
intro: Acis autumnalis var. oporantha, commonly known as autumnal gentian or autumn gentian, is a plant species in the gentian family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful for soothing digestive issues and alleviating stress. The therapeutic actions of Acis autumnalis var. oporantha include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of gastrointestinal issues, as well as its potential to exert a mild sedative effect. The bioactive constituents of this plant include xanthones and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its exact effects and potential uses.
